prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Cottus, the fifty-headed hundred-armed Greek giant. This commission depends on EXACT anatomical counts, not approximate masses.
ANATOMY LAYOUT: ONE huge torso with TWO legs, opaque battle kilt. His FIFTY necks and heads form a rectangular five-row crown growing out of his immense shoulders. ROW 1 (top): EXACTLY TEN heads. ROW 2: EXACTLY TEN heads. ROW 3: EXACTLY TEN heads. ROW 4: EXACTLY TEN heads. ROW 5 (lowest, including central largest face): EXACTLY TEN heads. Each row separated by a clean visible gap of dark background; no head hidden. All fifty heads are living male heads and contiguous with shoulders, not masks or decorations. There is NO additional main head outside this grid. [cottus-c05]
ARMS: EXACTLY100arms. Ten horizontal levels. Each level has FIVE clearly separate arms extending left and FIVE extending right. TEN levels x TEN arms =100. Straight radial fan, wrists and all hands visible. Do not merge or hide hands, do not crop any arm, no vague multilimbed blur. Each arm carries ONE small jagged rock, so100rocks held in100hands. [cottus-c05,cottus-c07]
MOMENT: Full giant looms over viewer, fifty mouths shout and hundred arms rear back to fling their boulders into battle. One torso, only two legs. The shoulders and arms fill upper80% of frame; legs are smaller in lower20%, giving room for precise50head/100arm layout.
POWER: Physical boulder-throwing battle against Titans only, dust, NO magic/lightning/aura. [cottus-c06,cottus-c07]
CAMERA: Low frontal full-body view with ALL heads and arm ends fully in square, immense size with tiny rocky mountains under his feet [cottus-c03].
LIGHT: one side sunset, warm gold rim on skin, deep walnut shadows, premium painterly brushwork, atmospheric battle dust.
SETTING: rocky Titan battlefield [cottus-c06]. Active awe-inspiring living giant, never statue or diagram.
HARD CONSTRAINTS:5rows of10heads,10levels of10arms; no head/arm omission. No text, numbers, labels, lettering, logos, border/watermark. No nudity/gore, no extra legs, no borrowed film/game design.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
